        "contents": "import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\nimport { hasEnvVars } from \"../utils\";\n\nexport async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  // If the env vars are not set, skip proxy check. You can remove this\n  // once you setup the project.\n  if (!hasEnvVars) {\n    return supabaseResponse;\n  }\n\n  // With Fluid compute, don't put this client in a global environment\n  // variable. Always create a new one on each request.\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt;\n            request.cookies.set(name, value),\n          );\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt;\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options),\n          );\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n  // Do not run code between createServerClient and\n  // supabase.auth.getClaims().         "contents": "import { type EmailOtpType } from \"@supabase/supabase-js\";\nimport { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\n\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n  const token_hash = searchParams.get(\"token_hash\");\n  const type = searchParams.get(\"type\") as EmailOtpType | null;\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\") ?? \"/\";\n\n  if (token_hash &amp;&amp; type) {\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n\n    const { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n      type,\n      token_hash,\n    });\n    if (!error) {\n      // redirect user to specified redirect URL or root of app\n      redirect(next);\n    } else {\n      // redirect the user to an error page with some instructions\n      redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=${error?.message}&#96;);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // redirect the user to an error page with some instructions\n  redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=No token hash or type&#96;);\n}",

        "contents": "export async function sendWorkEmailOTP(workEmail: string): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n(\"You must be signed in with Google first\");\n  }\n\n  // Send OTP to work email\n  // With manual linking enabled, this will automatically link the work email identity\n  // to the existing Google OAuth identity\n  const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n    email: workEmail,\n    options: {\n      shouldCreateUser: false,\n    },\n  });\n\n  if (error) {\n    throw new Error(error.message || \"Failed to send OTP\");\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Verifies OTP code and links profile to user if profile exists\n * @param workEmail - The work email address that received the OTP\n * @param otpCode - The OTP code entered by the user\n * @returns Object indicating if profile was found and linked\n * @throws Error if OTP verification fails or profile linking fails\n */\nexport async function verifyWorkEmailOTP(\n  workEmail: string,\n  otpCode: string,\n): Promise&lt;{ profileFound: boolean }&gt; {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n\n  // Verify OTP\n  const { error: verifyError } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n    email: workEmail,\n    token: otpCode,\n    type: \"email\",\n  });\n\n  if (verifyError) {\n    throw new Error(verifyError.message || \"Invalid verification code\");\n  }\n\n  // Get current authenticated user (should be the Google OAuth user)\n  const {\n    data: { user },\n    error: userError,\n  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (userError || !user) {\n    throw new Error(\"User not authenticated\");\n  }\n\n  // Sync user record to public.users table\n  const { error: syncError } = await supabase.from(\"users\").upsert(\n    {\n      id: user.id,\n      email: user.email!,\n      name: user.user_metadata?.full_name || user.user_metadata?.name || null,\n      picture: user.user_metadata?.avatar_url || null,\n    },\n    { onConflict: \"id\" },\n  );\n\n  if (syncError) {\n    console.error(\"Failed to sync user record:\", syncError);\n    // Don't fail the auth flow - user sync is not critical for login\n  }\n\n  // Check if profile exists for this work email\n  const { data: profile, error: profileError } = await supabase\n    .from(\"profiles\")\n    .select(\"id, user_id\")\n    .eq(\"work_email\", workEmail)\n    .single();\n\n  if (profileError || !profile) {\n    // No profile exists - user needs admin approval\n    return { profileFound: false };\n  }\n\n  // Profile exists - link it to the current user\n  const { error: linkError } = await supabase\n    .from(\"profiles\")\n    .update({\n      user_id: user.id,\n    })\n;\n}",

        "contents": "\"use server\";\n\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/server\";\nimport { isValidWorkEmailDomain } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\nimport { revalidatePath } from \"next/cache\";\n\n/**\n * Sends an OTP to the specified work email address\n * Validates domain before sending OTP\n * Requires user to be authenticated with Google OAuth first\n * @param workEmail - The work email address to send OTP to\n * @throws Error if domain validation fails, user not authenticated, or OTP sending fails\n */\nexport async function sendWorkEmailOTP(workEmail: string): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n  // Validate domain before sending OTP\n  if (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n    throw new Error(\"Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz\");\n  }\n\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n\n  // Ensure user is authenticated (should be authenticated via Google OAuth)\n  const {\n    data: { user },\n    error: authError,\n  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (authError || !user) {\n    throw new Error(\"You must be signed in with Google first\");\n  }\n\n  // Send OTP to work email\n  // With manual linking enabled, this will automatically link the work email identity\n}",

        "contents": "   - All access control handled by Next.js\n\n### Next.js (Application Layer - All Business Logic)\n\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\n\n   - Queries &#96;profiles&#96; table for linked user_id\n   - Checks &#96;removed_access&#96; is null for active access\n   - Enforces role-based route protection\n   - Real-time verification (instant access revocation)\n\n2. **Domain Validation** (in server actions):\n\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\n   - Validates email format and CZU domain\n\n3. **Access Management** (in server actions):\n\n   - Admin sets &#96;removed_access&#96; timestamp and &#96;removed_access_by&#96; profile\n   - Immediate effect on next request\n   - Audit trail of who revoked access and when\n\n## Authentication Flow Details\n\n### Step 1: Google Login\n\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handles OAuth flow.\n\n### Step 2: Work Email Input with Domain Validation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Validate domain before sending OTP\nif (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n  throw new Error('Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz');\n}\n\n// Send OTP to work email (only after domain validation passes)\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  options: { shouldCreateUser: false }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: OTP Verification and Profile Linking\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// After user enters OTP, verify it\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  token: otpCode,\n  type: 'email'\n});\n\n// Check if profile exists for this work email\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id')\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) {\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval\n  redirect('/auth/pending-approval');\n}\n\n// Link profile to current user\nconst { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\nawait supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .update({ \n    user_id: user.id,\n    picture: user.user_metadata.avatar_url  // Default to Google picture\n  })\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 4: Middleware Validation",

        "contents": "## Architecture Overview\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&gt; B[Google OAuth]\n        B --&gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\n        C --&gt; D{Profile linked to user?}\n        D --&gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\n        E --&gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\n        F --&gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\n        G --&gt; E\n        F --&gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]\n        H --&gt; I[User enters OTP]\n        I --&gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}\n        J --&gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]\n        J --&gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]\n        D --&gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}\n        L --&gt; M\n        M --&gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]\n        M --&gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]\n    end\n\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\n        P[Incoming Request] --&gt; Q[Middleware queries database]\n        Q --&gt; R{Profile linked to user?}\n        R --&gt;|No| S[Redirect to verify email]\n        R --&gt;|Yes| T{removed_access is null?}\n        T --&gt;|No| U[Show access revoked]\n        T --&gt;|Yes| V[Allow access]\n    end\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Validation Flow\n\n**Two-stage validation:**\n\n1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96; or &#96;@pef.czu.cz&#96;\n\n   - Client-side: Immediate feedback\n   - Server-side: Validated before &#96;signInWithOtp&#96; is called\n\n2. **After OTP (Profile Linking)**: Check if a profile exists for the verified work email\n\n   - If profile exists with that work_email → link profile to auth.user\n   - If no profile exists → show \"Pending Approval\" (admin must create profile first)\n   - Checked on every request via middleware\n\n## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)\n\nTwo tables with **no RLS** - all access control is handled in Next.js:\n\n1. **&#96;users&#96;** - Custom table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth), synced via Next.js server actions\n2. **&#96;profiles&#96;** - User authentication profile data with role and access control\n\n**Important**: No Supabase functions, triggers, or RLS policies. All business logic lives in Next.js.\n\nUse MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.",

            "text": "   - If profile exists with that work_email → link profile to auth.user",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "   - If no profile exists → show \"Pending Approval\" (admin must create profile first)",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Checked on every request via middleware",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "Two tables with **no RLS** - all access control is handled in Next.js:",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **&#96;users&#96;** - Custom table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth), synced via Next.js server actions",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **&#96;profiles&#96;** - User authentication profile data with role and access control",
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "**Important**: No Supabase functions, triggers, or RLS policies. All business logic lives in Next.js.",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "Use MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.",
            "lineNumber": 96
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.3671014904975891
    },

        "contents": "&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth]\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\n\n[auth.email]\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\n\n[auth.external.google]\nenabled = true\nclient_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"\nsecret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)\n\nAll verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:\n\n- **Profile Linked**: Check &#96;profiles.user_id&#96; matches current auth.user.id\n- **Access Active**: Check &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;\n- **User Role**: Read &#96;profiles.role&#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)\n\nThis approach:\n\n- Keeps all business logic in Next.js (single source of truth)\n- Allows real-time updates (e.g., instant access revocation)\n- Admin pre-creates profiles, users link via work email verification\n- Supabase only handles auth + data storage (no custom hooks or functions)\n\n## Development &amp; Testing with Supabase MCP\n\nThe project has a &#96;supabase/&#96; directory with Supabase MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration available for:\n\n1. **Running migrations**: Apply and test database schema changes locally\n2. **Debugging auth flow**: Inspect user sessions and profile data\n3. **Testing verification logic**: Query profiles table for auth checks\n\n**Useful MCP commands for development:**\n\n- Seed test data into profiles table for auth testing\n- Inspect auth.users and profiles tables\n- Test profile linking and access revocation queries\n\n## Key Security Features\n\n### Supabase (Data Layer Only)\n\n1. **Database Constraints**:\n\n   - Domain constraint ensures only valid CZU domains in profiles\n   - Unique constraints on work_email, user_id\n\n2. **No RLS or Functions**:\n\n   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions\n   - All access control handled by Next.js",

        "contents": "  .eq('work_email', workEmail);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 4: Middleware Validation\n\nQuery database for profile linked to current auth.user and check &#96;removed_access IS NULL&#96; on every request to protected routes.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Middleware check\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id, role, removed_access')\n  .eq('user_id', user.id)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) redirect('/auth/verify-work-email');\nif (profile.removed_access) redirect('/auth/access-revoked');\n// User has active access, continue...\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Estimated Complexity\n\n| Task | Complexity | Lines of Code |\n\n|------|------------|---------------|\n\n| Delete old auth files | Trivial | -500 lines |\n\n| Security lockdown config | Trivial | ~20 lines TOML |\n\n| Database migration | Low | ~40 lines SQL (users, profiles, indexes) |\n\n| Constants + validation | Trivial | ~25 lines |\n\n| Server actions (auth logic) | Medium | ~60 lines |\n\n| Middleware update | Medium | ~50 lines (includes DB queries) |\n\n| Google login page | Low | ~30 lines |\n\n| Work email form + linking | Medium | ~120 lines |\n\n| Pending approval page | Low | ~20 lines |\n\n| Access revoked page | Low | ~20 lines |\n\n**Total new code**: ~385 lines (vs ~500 lines deleted)\n\n## Separation of Concerns\n\n### Supabase (Auth + Storage Only)\n\n- **Authentication**: Google OAuth flow, session management, OTP emails\n- **Database**: Store profiles and users data (no RLS - Next.js handles access control)\n- **No business logic**: No custom hooks, no stored procedures, no triggers, no functions\n\n### Next.js (All Business Logic)\n\n- **Middleware**: Profile verification, access checks, role-based routing\n- **Server Actions**: Profile linking, access revocation\n- **Validation**: Domain validation, input sanitization, business rules\n- **Authorization**: Role hierarchy checks, permission enforcement\n&#96;&#96;&#96;",

        "contents": "file_size_limit = \"50MiB\"\n\n# Uncomment to configure local storage buckets\n# [storage.buckets.images]\n# public = false\n# file_size_limit = \"50MiB\"\n# allowed_mime_types = [\"image/png\", \"image/jpeg\"]\n# objects_path = \"./images\"\n\n# Allow connections via S3 compatible clients\n[storage.s3_protocol]\nenabled = true\n\n# Image transformation API is available to Supabase Pro plan.\n# [storage.image_transformation]\n# enabled = true\n\n# Store analytical data in S3 for running ETL jobs over Iceberg Catalog\n# This feature is only available on the hosted platform.\n[storage.analytics]\nenabled = false\nmax_namespaces = 5\nmax_tables = 10\nmax_catalogs = 2\n\n# Analytics Buckets is available to Supabase Pro plan.\n# [storage.analytics.buckets.my-warehouse]\n\n# Store vector embeddings in S3 for large and durable datasets\n# This feature is only available on the hosted platform.\n[storage.vector]\nenabled = false\nmax_buckets = 10\nmax_indexes = 5\n\n# Vector Buckets is available to Supabase Pro plan.\n# [storage.vector.buckets.documents-openai]\n\n[auth]\nenabled = true\n# The base URL of your website. Used as an allow-list for redirects and for constructing URLs used\n# in emails.\nsite_url = \"http://127.0.0.1:3000\"\n# A list of *exact* URLs that auth providers are permitted to redirect to post authentication.\nadditional_redirect_urls = [\"https://127.0.0.1:3000\"]\n# How long tokens are valid for, in seconds. Defaults to 3600 (1 hour), maximum 604,800 (1 week).\njwt_expiry = 3600\n# JWT issuer URL.         "contents": "### ORM Best Practices\n\n- Use type-safe ORMs (Drizzle, Prisma, etc.)\n- Define schemas with proper relationships and constraints\n- Infer types from schema definitions\n- Write repository-style helpers to isolate queries\n- Implement proper migrations\n\n### Data Access Patterns\n\n- Keep database queries in dedicated modules\n- Avoid N+1 queries; use joins and CTEs\n- Implement pagination for list endpoints\n- Use select projections to limit payload size\n\n## Authentication &amp; Authorization\n\n- Implement server-side auth checks\n- Never trust client-side auth flags\n- Use middleware for route protection\n- Store user data securely with proper encryption\n\n## Testing Strategy\n\n### Unit Testing (Vitest)\n\n- **Never mock internal code** - only mock external dependencies\n- Use MSW for API mocking when needed\n- Test utilities, repositories, and business logic\n- Mock external services (APIs, databases, file systems)\n\n### Component Testing (React Testing Library)\n\n- Test interactive components with proper accessibility\n- Ensure loading and error states are covered\n- Test user interactions and state changes\n- Use data-testid sparingly; prefer semantic queries\n\n### Integration Testing\n\n- Test API endpoints with real database connections\n- Use test databases with proper cleanup\n- Test authentication flows end-to-end\n- Mock external services consistently\n\n### Test Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Example test structure\ndescribe(\"Feature\", () =&gt; {\n  describe(\"when condition\", () =&gt; {\n    it(\"should expected behavior\", async () =&gt; {\n      // Arrange\n      // Act\n      // Assert\n    });\n  });\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Error Handling &amp; Observability\n\n- Implement early returns on invalid input (fail fast)\n- Use typed error codes and messages\n- Log server-side with contextual metadata\n- Never expose stack traces to clients\n- Provide user-friendly error messages\n\n## Security Best Practices\n\n- Validate all inputs at boundaries\n- Use environment variables for sensitive data (server-only)\n- Implement proper CORS policies\n- Sanitize user inputs\n- Use HTTPS in production\n- Implement rate limiting where appropriate",

        "contents": "│  │              Supabase Client (data access only)             ││\n│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘│\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n                           │\n                           ▼\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                        Supabase                                  │\n│  ┌─────────────────────┐  ┌─────────────────────────────────┐   │\n│  │   Auth Service      │  │         PostgreSQL              │   │\n│  │  - Google OAuth     │  │  - profiles table               │   │\n│  │  - OTP emails       │  │  - users table                  │   │\n│  │  - Session mgmt     │  │  - No RLS (Next.js handles)     │   │\n│  └─────────────────────┘  └─────────────────────────────────┘   │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n\n## Simplicity Principles\n\n1. **Business logic in Next.js** - Server actions and middleware handle all rules\n2. **Supabase for storage only** - No hooks, no custom functions, no RLS, just tables\n3. **Minimal components** - Reuse shadcn/ui, no custom abstractions\n4. **Direct database queries** - Query profiles table for verification and access status\n5. **Admin-first onboarding** - Admin creates profiles, users link via work email verification\n\n# Common Traps to Avoid\n\n1.         "contents": "skip_nonce_check = false\n# If enabled, it will allow the user to successfully authenticate when the provider does not return an email address.\nemail_optional = false\n\n[auth.external.google]\nenabled = true\nclient_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"\nsecret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"\nskip_nonce_check = false\nemail_optional = false\n\n# Allow Solana wallet holders to sign in to your project via the Sign in with Solana (SIWS, EIP-4361) standard.\n# You can configure \"web3\" rate limit in the [auth.rate_limit] section and set up [auth.captcha] if self-hosting.\n[auth.web3.solana]\nenabled = false\n\n# Use Firebase Auth as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.firebase]\nenabled = false\n# project_id = \"my-firebase-project\"\n\n# Use Auth0 as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.auth0]\nenabled = false\n# tenant = \"my-auth0-tenant\"\n# tenant_region = \"us\"\n\n# Use AWS Cognito (Amplify) as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.aws_cognito]\nenabled = false\n# user_pool_id = \"my-user-pool-id\"\n# user_pool_region = \"us-east-1\"\n\n# Use Clerk as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.clerk]\nenabled = false\n# Obtain from https://clerk.com/setup/supabase\n# domain = \"example.clerk.accounts.dev\"\n\n# OAuth server configuration\n[auth.oauth_server]\n# Enable OAuth server functionality\nenabled = false\n# Path for OAuth consent flow UI\nauthorization_url_path = \"/oauth/consent\"\n# Allow dynamic client registration\nallow_dynamic_registration = false\n\n[edge_runtime]\nenabled = true\n# Supported request policies: &#96;oneshot&#96;, &#96;per_worker&#96;.\n# &#96;per_worker&#96;       "codeBlock": {

        },
        "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n  // If user is authenticated, check profile verification and access status\n  if (user) {\n    const { data: { user: authUser } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n    \n    if (authUser) {\n      // Query profiles table to check if user has linked profile and active access\n      const { data: profile } = await supabase\n        .from('profiles')\n        .select('id, role, removed_access')\n        .eq('user_id', authUser.id)\n        .single();\n\n      // If no profile linked, redirect to work email verification\n      if (!profile &amp;&amp; !request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith('/auth/verify-work-email') &amp;&amp; !request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith('/auth/pending-approval')) {\n        const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n        url.pathname = '/auth/verify-work-email';\n        const redirectResponse = NextResponse.redirect(url);\n        redirectResponse.cookies.setAll(supabaseResponse.cookies.getAll());\n        return redirectResponse;\n      }\n\n      // If access revoked, redirect to access revoked page\n      if (profile &amp;&amp; profile.removed_access &amp;&amp; !request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith('/auth/access-revoked')) {\n        const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n        url.pathname = '/auth/access-revoked';\n        const redirectResponse = NextResponse.redirect(url);\n        redirectResponse.cookies.setAll(supabaseResponse.cookies.getAll());\n        return redirectResponse;\n      }\n\n      // If profile exists but user is on pending approval page, redirect to verify\n      if (profile &amp;&amp; request.nextUrl.pathname === '/auth/pending-approval') {\n        const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n        url.pathname = '/auth/verify-work-email';\n        const redirectResponse = NextResponse.redirect(url);\n        redirectResponse.cookies.setAll(supabaseResponse.cookies.getAll());\n        return redirectResponse;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // If not authenticated and trying to access protected route, redirect to login\n  if (\n    !user &amp;&amp;\n    !isPublicRoute &amp;&amp;\n    !request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith('/auth')\n  ) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = '/auth/login';\n    const redirectResponse = NextResponse.redirect(url);\n    redirectResponse.cookies.setAll(supabaseResponse.cookies.getAll());\n}",

        "contents": "   - All access control handled by Next.js\n\n### Next.js (Application Layer - All Business Logic)\n\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\n\n   - Queries &#96;profiles&#96; table for linked user_id\n   - Checks &#96;removed_access&#96; is null for active access\n   - Enforces role-based route protection\n   - Real-time verification (instant access revocation)\n\n2. **Domain Validation** (in server actions):\n\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\n   - Validates email format and CZU domain\n\n3. **Access Management** (in server actions):\n\n   - Admin sets &#96;removed_access&#96; timestamp and &#96;removed_access_by&#96; profile\n   - Immediate effect on next request\n   - Audit trail of who revoked access and when\n\n## Authentication Flow Details\n\n### Step 1: Google Login\n\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handles OAuth flow.\n\n### Step 2: Work Email Input with Domain Validation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Validate domain before sending OTP\nif (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n  throw new Error('Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz');\n}\n\n// Send OTP to work email (only after domain validation passes)\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  options: { shouldCreateUser: false }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: OTP Verification and Profile Linking\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// After user enters OTP, verify it\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  token: otpCode,\n  type: 'email'\n});\n\n// Check if profile exists for this work email\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id')\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) {\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval\n  redirect('/auth/pending-approval');\n}\n\n// Link profile to current user\nconst { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\nawait supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .update({ \n    user_id: user.id,\n    picture: user.user_metadata.avatar_url  // Default to Google picture\n  })\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 4: Middleware Validation",

        "contents": "import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\nimport { hasEnvVars } from \"../utils\";\n\nexport async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  // If the env vars are not set, skip proxy check. You can remove this\n  // once you setup the project.\n  if (!hasEnvVars) {\n    return supabaseResponse;\n  }\n\n  // With Fluid compute, don't put this client in a global environment\n  // variable. Always create a new one on each request.\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt;\n            request.cookies.set(name, value),\n          );\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt;\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options),\n          );\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n  // Do not run code between createServerClient and\n  // supabase.auth.getClaims(). A simple mistake could make it very hard to debug\n  // issues with users being randomly logged out.\n\n  // IMPORTANT: If you remove getClaims() and you use server-side rendering\n  // with the Supabase client, your users may be randomly logged out.\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n  const user = data?.claims;\n\n  // Public routes that don't require authentication\n  const publicRoutes = ['/', '/auth/login', '/auth/sign-up', '/auth/error', '/auth/forgot-password', '/auth/sign-up-success'];\n  const isPublicRoute = publicRoutes.some(route =&gt; request.nextUrl.pathname === route || request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith('/auth/confirm'));\n\n  // If user is authenticated, check profile verification and access status\n  if (user) {\n    const { data: { user: authUser } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./lib/actions/auth.ts",
        "range": {

        "contents": "export async function sendWorkEmailOTP(workEmail: string): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n(\"You must be signed in with Google first\");\n  }\n\n  // Send OTP to work email\n  // With manual linking enabled, this will automatically link the work email identity\n  // to the existing Google OAuth identity\n  const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n    email: workEmail,\n    options: {\n      shouldCreateUser: false,\n    },\n  });\n\n  if (error) {\n    throw new Error(error.message || \"Failed to send OTP\");\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Verifies OTP code and links profile to user if profile exists\n * @param workEmail - The work email address that received the OTP\n * @param otpCode - The OTP code entered by the user\n * @returns Object indicating if profile was found and linked\n * @throws Error if OTP verification fails or profile linking fails\n */\nexport async function verifyWorkEmailOTP(\n  workEmail: string,\n  otpCode: string,\n): Promise&lt;{ profileFound: boolean }&gt; {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n\n  // Verify OTP\n  const { error: verifyError } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n    email: workEmail,\n    token: otpCode,\n    type: \"email\",\n  });\n\n  if (verifyError) {\n    throw new Error(verifyError.message || \"Invalid verification code\");\n  }\n\n  // Get current authenticated user (should be the Google OAuth user)\n  const {\n    data: { user },\n    error: userError,\n  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (userError || !user) {\n    throw new Error(\"User not authenticated\");\n  }\n\n  // Sync user record to public.users table\n  const { error: syncError } = await supabase.from(\"users\").upsert(\n    {\n      id: user.id,\n      email: user.email!,\n      name: user.user_metadata?.full_name || user.user_metadata?.name || null,\n      picture: user.user_metadata?.avatar_url || null,\n    },\n    { onConflict: \"id\" },\n  );\n\n  if (syncError) {\n    console.error(\"Failed to sync user record:\", syncError);\n    // Don't fail the auth flow - user sync is not critical for login\n  }\n\n  // Check if profile exists for this work email\n  const { data: profile, error: profileError } = await supabase\n    .from(\"profiles\")\n    .select(\"id, user_id\")\n    .eq(\"work_email\", workEmail)\n    .single();\n\n  if (profileError || !profile) {\n    // No profile exists - user needs admin approval\n    return { profileFound: false };\n  }\n\n  // Profile exists - link it to the current user\n  const { error: linkError } = await supabase\n    .from(\"profiles\")\n    .update({\n      user_id: user.id,\n    })\n;\n}",

        "contents": "## Architecture Overview\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&gt; B[Google OAuth]\n        B --&gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\n        C --&gt; D{Profile linked to user?}\n        D --&gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\n        E --&gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\n        F --&gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\n        G --&gt; E\n        F --&gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]\n        H --&gt; I[User enters OTP]\n        I --&gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}\n        J --&gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]\n        J --&gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]\n        D --&gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}\n        L --&gt; M\n        M --&gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]\n        M --&gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]\n    end\n\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\n        P[Incoming Request] --&gt; Q[Middleware queries database]\n        Q --&gt; R{Profile linked to user?}\n        R --&gt;|No| S[Redirect to verify email]\n        R --&gt;|Yes| T{removed_access is null?}\n        T --&gt;|No| U[Show access revoked]\n        T --&gt;|Yes| V[Allow access]\n    end\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Validation Flow\n\n**Two-stage validation:**\n\n1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96; or &#96;@pef.czu.cz&#96;\n\n   - Client-side: Immediate feedback\n   - Server-side: Validated before &#96;signInWithOtp&#96; is called\n\n2. **After OTP (Profile Linking)**: Check if a profile exists for the verified work email\n\n   - If profile exists with that work_email → link profile to auth.user\n   - If no profile exists → show \"Pending Approval\" (admin must create profile first)\n   - Checked on every request via middleware\n\n## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)\n\nTwo tables with **no RLS** - all access control is handled in Next.js:\n\n1. **&#96;users&#96;** - Custom table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth), synced via Next.js server actions\n2. **&#96;profiles&#96;** - User authentication profile data with role and access control\n\n**Important**: No Supabase functions, triggers, or RLS policies. All business logic lives in Next.js.\n\nUse MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.",

        "contents": "\"use server\";\n\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/server\";\nimport { isValidWorkEmailDomain } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\nimport { revalidatePath } from \"next/cache\";\n\n/**\n * Sends an OTP to the specified work email address\n * Validates domain before sending OTP\n * Requires user to be authenticated with Google OAuth first\n * @param workEmail - The work email address to send OTP to\n * @throws Error if domain validation fails, user not authenticated, or OTP sending fails\n */\nexport async function sendWorkEmailOTP(workEmail: string): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n  // Validate domain before sending OTP\n  if (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n    throw new Error(\"Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz\");\n  }\n\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n\n  // Ensure user is authenticated (should be authenticated via Google OAuth)\n  const {\n    data: { user },\n    error: authError,\n  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (authError || !user) {\n    throw new Error(\"You must be signed in with Google first\");\n  }\n\n  // Send OTP to work email\n  // With manual linking enabled, this will automatically link the work email identity\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.cursor/plans/work_email_auth_system_467a2b18.plan.md",

          "endPosition": {

        "contents": "&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth]\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\n\n[auth.email]\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\n\n[auth.external.google]\nenabled = true\nclient_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"\nsecret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)\n\nAll verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:\n\n- **Profile Linked**: Check &#96;profiles.user_id&#96; matches current auth.user.id\n- **Access Active**: Check &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;\n- **User Role**: Read &#96;profiles.role&#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)\n\nThis approach:\n\n- Keeps all business logic in Next.js (single source of truth)\n- Allows real-time updates (e.g., instant access revocation)\n- Admin pre-creates profiles, users link via work email verification\n- Supabase only handles auth + data storage (no custom hooks or functions)\n\n## Development &amp; Testing with Supabase MCP\n\nThe project has a &#96;supabase/&#96; directory with Supabase MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration available for:\n\n1. **Running migrations**: Apply and test database schema changes locally\n2. **Debugging auth flow**: Inspect user sessions and profile data\n3. **Testing verification logic**: Query profiles table for auth checks\n\n**Useful MCP commands for development:**\n\n- Seed test data into profiles table for auth testing\n- Inspect auth.users and profiles tables\n- Test profile linking and access revocation queries\n\n## Key Security Features\n\n### Supabase (Data Layer Only)\n\n1. **Database Constraints**:\n\n   - Domain constraint ensures only valid CZU domains in profiles\n   - Unique constraints on work_email, user_id\n\n2. **No RLS or Functions**:\n\n   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions\n   - All access control handled by Next.js",

github.event.inputs.environment == 'preview')\n    env:\n      SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN }}\n      PROJECT_ID: ${{ vars.SUPABASE_PREVIEW_PROJECT_ID }}\n      \n    steps:\n      - uses: actions/checkout@v4\n      \n      - uses: supabase/setup-cli@v1\n        with:\n          version: latest\n          \n      - name: Link Supabase project\n        run: |\n          supabase link --project-ref $PROJECT_ID\n          \n      - name: Deploy database migrations\n        run: |\n          supabase db push\n          \n      - name: Deploy Edge Functions\n        continue-on-error: true\n        run: |\n          if [ -d \"supabase/functions\" ] &amp;&amp; [ \"$(ls -A supabase/functions)\" ]; then\n            echo \"Deploying Edge Functions...\"\n            supabase functions deploy\n          else\n            echo \"No Edge Functions found, skipping deployment.\"\n          fi\n          \n      - name: Deploy Edge Function secrets\n        continue-on-error: true\n        run: |\n          if [ -f \"supabase/.env.secrets\" ]; then\n            echo \"Deploying Edge Function secrets...\"\n            supabase secrets set --env-file supabase/.env.secrets\n          else\n            echo \"No secrets file found, skipping secrets deployment.\"\n          fi\n          \n  deploy_production:\n    environment: production\n    runs-on: blacksmith-2vcpu-ubuntu-2404\n    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/production' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &amp;&amp; ## Summary

Implemented the work email authentication system per the plan. Completed:

### Completed tasks

1. Database schema — Tables (`users`, `profiles`) and enum (`profile_role`) already exist
2. Auth constants — Created `lib/constants/auth.ts` with domain validation and role constants
3. Supabase config — Updated `supabase/config.toml`:
   - Enabled `manual_linking = true`
   - Disabled `enable_signup = false` for email signups
   - Added Google OAuth configuration
4. Server actions — Already implemented in `lib/actions/auth.ts`:
   - `sendWorkEmailOTP` — Sends OTP to work email
   - `verifyWorkEmailOTP` — Verifies OTP and links profile
   - `revokeUserAccess` — Revokes user access (admin only)
   - `restoreUserAccess` — Restores user access (admin only)
5. Middleware — Updated `lib/supabase/proxy.ts` to:
   - Query profiles table for verification status
   - Check `removed_access` for access revocation
   - Redirect users based on profile status
   - Preserve cookies on redirects
6. Google login — Created `components/google-login-button.tsx` and updated login page
7. Work email verification — Created `app/auth/verify-work-email/page.tsx` with:
   - Email input with domain validation
   - OTP input form
   - Profile linking logic
8. Pending approval page — Created `app/auth/pending-approval/page.tsx`
9. Access revoked page — Created `app/auth/access-revoked/page.tsx`

### Authentication flow

1. User clicks "Continue with Google" → Google OAuth flow
2. After Google auth → Redirects to `/auth/verify-work-email`
3. User enters work email → Domain validation → OTP sent
4. User enters OTP → Verification → Profile linking
5. If profile exists → Access granted → Redirect to `/protected`
6. If no profile → Redirect to `/auth/pending-approval`
7. Middleware checks on every request → Redirects based on profile status

### Security features

- Domain validation (client and server)
- Database-based profile verification (no JWT claims)
- Access revocation via `removed_access` timestamp
- Middleware enforces access control on all requests
- Admin-only access management functions

Implementation is complete and ready for testing. Ensure `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID` and `GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET` are set in your environment variables.
